description: This file contains utility functions for analyzing Python source files in a project. It includes functions to extract function names from files, identify functions called within test directories, and specifically parse router-related files to identify defined functions. The script also contains a main function that checks whether all router functions are tested in associated test files.

methods.name: get_function_names_from_file(file_path)
methods.description: Extracts all top-level and class-contained function names from a Python file by parsing its AST.

methods.name: get_all_functions_called_in_tests(base_dir)
methods.description: Walks through specified test directories to find all function calls in files containing 'router' in their name.

methods.name: get_functions_from_router(file_path)
methods.description: Retrieves all function names defined within a router.py file.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Orchestrates the process to check which router functions are not tested and outputs the result or raises an exception if untested functions are found.
